articles.title: Kentucky targets prediction markets, puts Trump-aligned state in potential clash with president's team
articles.snippet: President Donald Trump has taken the stance that states have no business with firms like Kalshi and Polymarket, and now a staunch GOP state is defying that view.

articles.title: Kentucky sues Kalshi, Polymarket, joining prediction market legal battle
articles.snippet: Kentucky has sued Polymarket, Kalshi and Kalshi’s partners Coinbase, Robinhood and Webull, over offering sports event contracts in the state.

articles.title: Kentucky Sues Kalshi, Polymarket as Prediction Market Legal Battle Swells
articles.snippet: Kentucky accused America’s top prediction market platforms of running illegal sports betting operations, joining a growing stack of states.

articles.title: Jerome Powell Supports Fed's New Stablecoin Policies—But Chair Kevin Warsh Abstains
articles.snippet: The proposed rulemaking establishes how U.S. crypto companies will have to screen stablecoin customers after the passage of the GENIUS Act.

articles.title: Michigan Federal Judge Rules Sports Prediction Markets Are Not Under CFTC Purview
articles.snippet: The judge said Polymarket is not likely to succeed on the merits of its case against Michigan state regulators.
